# EvalSutra AI

> Evidence-first, offline, keyless evaluation of AI agents. CLI plus 18 portable agent skills (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Gemini CLI, GitHub Copilot). Zero dependencies, Apache-2.0, created by Vatsal Shah.

EvalSutra grades recorded agent observations (output, tool calls, latency) with deterministic assertions, treats missing evidence as inconclusive, never lets model-judge opinions prove a pass, gates releases as NO_GO / REVIEW / GO_CANDIDATE, compares runs for regressions, analyses tool traces, builds reproducibility capsules and audits itself (29 checks, Markdown + HTML reports). It does not run agents or call models.

## Quick start
npx evalsutra run --suite suites/demo.json --observations examples/demo-observations.json --out artifacts/demo
